title: metadata-protocol: the <base>.custom ensure door — the one idempotent creation path for the paired package, explicit <base namespace>_custom, walled 403
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P1, cut after ADR-0146's rewrite merged in #28295); D3's auto-create is epic ruling D-3, and Q4 「全部同意」 fixes the explicit `<base namespace>_custom`. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28404

Part of #28236 (P1, child **N-13**) · governs: ADR-0146 D3, Supersede row ADR-0070 D3/D5 (paired case) · lane: `domain:server` (`packages/metadata-protocol`, `packages/runtime`; spec half rides N-08) · size: M.

**This card is the `.custom` ensure door**, the **only creation path** for `<base>.custom` (D3: "no second door builds the pair"). It is consumed by N-21 (#28149, the clone door's default target; comment 6542769510 asks for its `Blocked-by:` to point here), by N-16 (the migration) and by the P2 Studio writes. Once this card is filed, #28149's `Blocked-by:` moves to it. Why it waits on N-08: N-08 carries the pair-id constant and the namespace rule, and this door reads them, ⛔ never a local copy.

**Business reason.** A customer's first change to an installed app has to land somewhere real: a package that exports, deploys and is never mixed up with another app's customizations. One door creates it the same way every time, so Studio, the clone and the migration never build three different packages.

**Measured (`75ecaf4ad8`).**
- No path creates or ensures a `.custom` package (`git grep` over `packages/**/src`: no hit).
- `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts:248–250` derives a missing namespace with `deriveNamespaceFromPackageId`, which gives `custom` for every `x.custom`.
- `spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts:18` `NAMESPACE_RE = /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,19}$/`: `<ns>_custom` is valid only for a base namespace of ≤ 13 characters.
- `runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:1379–1382` (install) and `:2443–2447` (duplicate) gate with `requireManageMetadata` + `refuseWalledCatalogPackageWrite`.
- `metadata-protocol/src/package-writability.ts#isWritablePackage` is the one read-only predicate.

**Wanted.**
1. One protocol primitive plus one HTTP route over it (route ledger, spec request/response schemas, SDK, OpenAPI). Given a base id, it answers the pair and whether it was created or already there.
2. It creates through `installPackage`, with:
   - id from N-08's constant;
   - `namespace` = `<base namespace>_custom`, set explicitly so the derivation never runs;
   - `dependencies: { <base>: '^<major of the base manifest.version>' }`;
   - a writable package.
3. Idempotent: an existing valid pair is returned unchanged, never rewritten. Two concurrent calls leave one pair.
4. Worded refusals that leave nothing behind:
   - the base is not installed, is writable (customize it directly), or is itself a pair;
   - the base declares no namespace;
   - the composed namespace fails `NAMESPACE_RE` or is owned by another package;
   - an existing `<base>.custom` lacks the dependency or the namespace (named, never adopted).
5. Authority as the install door: `manage_metadata` under `single`; under `group` / `isolated` only the platform operator, and a tenant administrator gets `403`.
6. `POST /packages` and `/duplicate` refuse a pair-shaped id whose manifest breaks item 2, naming this door. An exported pair that carries both still installs (ADR-0141 D2 judges its range).

**Tests.** Ensure creates `crm_custom` (not `custom`) with `^<major>`; a re-ensure is a no-op; each refusal leaves no package; walled tenant admin gets 403 and the operator 201; concurrency. `namespace-prefix.test.ts` and `protocol.duplicate-package-target-namespace.test.ts` stay green.

**Not here.** Constants and the namespace rule (N-08); uninstall protection (N-14); the clone door (N-21); migration (N-16); Studio's folded switcher (N-19).

**Dedupe.** Searched `custom package`, `.custom package ensure`, `namespace custom derived`: only #28149 (consumer), #28390, #28236. No card creates the pair.

Links back: #28236, #28149, ADR-0146 D3, ADR-0070 D3, ADR-0141 D1/D2, ADR-0048 §3.2.
